name: Enforced Penance

tenures.role: tag team — M.o.A enforcers, "back from Japan"
tenures.source: the fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast (promotions/bew/archive/night-of-armageddon.html)

notes: Named as a pair once, by the fed's own commentary ("Redemption and WolfsBane back from Japan! Enforced Penance in da house!"), billed a former dominant M.o.A tag team in the WCIWA who left for Japan before returning for this show. Do not wrestle a match of their own; work together restraining and beating Greg Eskridge, then join the M.o.A's own post-match assault on Kevin Merrix, where both men are separately knocked down by the rescuing Vigilance/Anderson/Hope save.
caption: A former dominant M.o.A tag team, "back from Japan" to enforce the stable's own will at Night of Armageddon.

name: the Guild

tenures.source: the fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast (promotions/bew/archive/night-of-armageddon.html)

notes: Named once by commentary ("Prophet's stable mate Harvester of Pain") and once more as "IHOP and Daft... members of the Guild"; membership beyond these two carried-over members is not confirmed in the held corpus (v89(c) honest gap — the broadcast never names the Guild's own full roster).
caption: Jonathan Prophet's own stable, its two other named members coming to his aid after his crucifixion-match loss at Night of Armageddon.

identity.note: the-guild (nfw) is a wholly unrelated, later-era (2011-2012) NFW stable with unknown membership — no shared fed, era, or named member with this 1999 BEW stable. Filed distinct pending evidence, per the collision doctrine.
